metrics.name: Settled Ad Revenue
metrics.description: Total post-fraud ad revenue that actually settled: the marketing-truth revenue line (excludes invalid traffic).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(settled_revenue), 2) AS value FROM ad_impression_events
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(SUM(settled_revenue), 2) AS value FROM ad_impression_events GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Reported Ad Revenue
metrics.description: Gross MMP-reported ad revenue before fraud settlement: what the dashboards show before invalid traffic is removed.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS value FROM ad_impression_events
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS value FROM ad_impression_events GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Net Revenue (Post-Platform-Fee)
metrics.description: Settled ad revenue after the 30% platform fee: the revenue Finance actually books.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS value FROM ad_impression_events
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS value FROM ad_impression_events GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Fraud Revenue Loss
metrics.description: Reported revenue that never settled due to impression-stuffing fraud (reported minus settled).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue) - SUM(settled_revenue), 2) AS value FROM ad_impression_events
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(SUM(revenue) - SUM(settled_revenue), 2) AS value FROM ad_impression_events GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Total Installs
metrics.description: Count of all player installs across paid and organic channels.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM installs
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT install_date AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM installs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Daily Active Players (Avg)
metrics.description: Average distinct active player-days per calendar day across the dataset window.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(session_date AS DATE)), 0) AS value FROM sessions
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(session_date AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sessions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: ARPDAU
metrics.description: Average ad revenue per active player-day: the core ad-monetisation efficiency metric.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ad_revenue) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS value FROM sessions
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(session_date AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(SUM(ad_revenue) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS value FROM sessions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: ARPI (Settled Revenue per Install)
metrics.description: Lifetime settled ad revenue divided by total installs: blended revenue per acquired player to date.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(settled_revenue) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM installs), 4) AS value FROM ad_impression_events
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(ts AS DATE) AS date, ROUND(SUM(settled_revenue), 4) AS value FROM ad_impression_events GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: UA Spend
metrics.description: Total user-acquisition spend across all paid channels.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS value FROM campaign
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT cohort_date AS date, ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS value FROM campaign GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Blended CPI
metrics.description: Blended cost per install across paid channels (total spend / paid installs).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost) / NULLIF(SUM(installs), 0), 2) AS value FROM campaign
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT cohort_date AS date, ROUND(SUM(cost) / NULLIF(SUM(installs), 0), 2) AS value FROM campaign GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: D7 Retention
metrics.description: % of installed players still active around day 7: the core early-stickiness benchmark.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(d7_active) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(cohort_size), 0) * 100, 2) AS value FROM cohort_retention_actuals
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT (install_month || '-01')::DATE AS date, ROUND(SUM(d7_active) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(cohort_size), 0) * 100, 2) AS value FROM cohort_retention_actuals GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: D30 Retention
metrics.description: % of installed players still active around day 30: the LTV-relevant retention point. Has degraded across cohorts.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(d30_active) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(cohort_size), 0) * 100, 2) AS value FROM cohort_retention_actuals
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT (install_month || '-01')::DATE AS date, ROUND(SUM(d30_active) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(cohort_size), 0) * 100, 2) AS value FROM cohort_retention_actuals GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Blended D90 ROAS
metrics.description: Projected day-90 return on ad spend, blended across paid channels (D90 LTV revenue / UA spend). >1.0 = profitable at the 90-day horizon.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(d90_ltv * installs) / NULLIF(SUM(ua_spend), 0), 3) AS value FROM payback_analysis
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT (install_month || '-01')::DATE AS date, ROUND(SUM(d90_ltv * installs) / NULLIF(SUM(ua_spend), 0), 3) AS value FROM payback_analysis GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: High-Engagement Install Rate
metrics.description: % of installs that reached high engagement (5+ games in first 7 days): the quality signal for an install cohort.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE engagement_tier = 'high') * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS value FROM installs
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT install_date AS date, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE engagement_tier = 'high') * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS value FROM installs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Fraud Install Rate
metrics.description: % of installs flagged for impression-stuffing fraud: invalid traffic that reports revenue but never settles.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN is_fraud THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100, 2) AS value FROM installs
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT install_date AS date, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN is_fraud THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100, 2) AS value FROM installs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
